_doc: Asset contract for the POLARIS expedition kit. Blender is Z-up, the GLB is Y-up (glTF z = -Blender y). The rover and the sled face -z (Blender +y). One scene unit is 1 unit; the map draws 1 unit = 2 km, so the vehicles are exaggerated on purpose. Every browser-controlled part has a stable name and a pivot at its hinge, axle or centre. Ice chunks are one cell of the map (2.5 units): a separate low-poly top surface with UVs and a darker body, so the browser can colour and fracture the top. Proxy_Rover is the analysis volume and is never drawn.
